text:
tara: Quick sync request — can we route onboarding feedback & enablement signals into the CRM health scorer and automatically trigger the escalation playbook for 'renewal-risk' customers? Right now it's manual and slipping.
jonathan: +1, we saw a few renewals miss follow-ups last week. what's the minimal set of signals you want to feed in?
maria_cs: onboarding pulse NPS, first-30-day activity, feature-usage delta, and a manager note flag from success calls. also dedupe by account external_id.
sarah_enablement: on enablement side we can tag sessions with `enablement:low-engagement` if attendee count < 2 and no follow-up tasks created. that tag could map into the health scorer.
alex_prod: for the playbook automation I suggest two thresholds: score <= 40 => auto-create CS task + 1wk escalated touch; score <= 20 => immediate AE + CSM sync and onboarding remediation runbook.
tara: that aligns. ideally the pipeline writes a `health_event` row and the playbook system subscribes. can infra send a small webhook example?
infra-bot: here's a starter mapping we used in dev: ```json
{
  "pipeline": "onboard-feedback-v1",
  "outputs": ["health_event"],
  "mappings": {
    "nps": "nps_score",
    "usage_delta": "feature_delta_pct",
    "session_tag": "enablement_tag",
    "account_id": "external_id"
  },
  "webhook": "https://playbooks.internal/api/v1/events?source=onboard"
}
```
jonathan: perfect. couple of operational asks: 1) add a dedupe window so duplicate pulses within 24h don't double-penalize score, 2) add `source_platform` so we can filter sandbox vs prod.
maria_cs: noted. also request that playbook writes an `audit_reason` field when triggered so CS can trace why an escalation happened.
sarah_enablement: and add a tiny email template for the auto-task with steps for enablement to run quick remediation. i can draft.
tara: assigning owners: jonathan owns pipeline mapping and dedupe, maria owns playbook audit fields + templates with sarah, alex to update threshold routing rules in playbooks config. i'll follow up with a short PR template.
cs-bot: automation test deployed to staging for `onboard-feedback-v1` — 5 sample events created. :rocket:
jonathan: i'll validate staging and report by EOD. if green, promote to prod next Tue during low-traffic window.
tara: thanks everyone — this should cut manual triage by ~30% if thresholds are tuned right. tagging @sarah_enablement for the template draft. :thumbsup:
